title: common/src/testFixtures 에 DelegationContractTest driver 작성 + 각 버전 모듈에서 호출

tdd_exempt.reason: Integration test harness/fixture authoring; the test fixtures themselves constitute the TDD acceptance for FR-FIX/FR-CONV implementation phases. Meta-TDD on test infrastructure is impractical.

dod_check.item: DelegationContractTest driver 가 common testFixtures 에 존재
3개 버전 모듈 각각이 driver 를 호출하는 ServletNContractTest 보유
모든 어댑터 인터페이스의 모든 추상 메서드에 대해 위임 검증 자동 수행
dod_check.notes: Interface-based adapters (ServletRequest/Response, HttpServletRequest/Response, HttpSession, ServletContext) covered by reflection; Cookie/Part concrete classes covered by AdapterUnwrapAllClassesTest (FR-CONV-003/004); AsyncContext via AsyncContextConverter.

notes: T-PH005-02 = practical equivalent substitute for the deferred T-PH005-01 adapter-class unit tests (per user decision B). Contract test surface covers 41 new test cases (15 servlet5 + 13 servlet6 + 13 servlet61) verifying pure-delegation for all interface-based adapter methods. Conversion-policy methods explicitly blacklisted with inline rationale; alternative coverage already exists via dedicated converter unit tests + AdapterUnwrapAllClassesTest. Pre-existing SRS Verification Evidence section was missing on FR-TEST-002; added (empty table heading) before the MCP add_verification_evidence calls.
